summary: No evidence of installer-side harm in diezyyasha-baileys@9.1.1
details: Package diezyyasha-baileys@9.1.1 was scanned with no static or traced-code findings indicating installer-side harm. No exfiltration, install-time remote fetch-and-execute, silent-relay, credential harvesting, backdoor, or self-propagation behavior was identified in the analyzed content. The package name resembles a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library, which is a known family of forks with varying degrees of maintainer trust; name resemblance alone is not a supply-chain threat and is not a basis for a higher score.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
